data.name: Spice Island Beach Resort
data.address: Grand Anse Beach, The Lime, Grenada
data.description:
On Grand Anse Beach, this posh all-inclusive resort is 6 km from both Maurice Bishop International Airport and Fort George.
Chic suites provide free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, minibars, and tea and coffeemakers, plus sitting areas, and balconies or patios; some have gardens. Upgraded suites offer living rooms, private pools and include airport transfers; some have beachfront settings, wet bars and/or saunas. Room service is available.
Golf, tennis, water sports and loaner bikes are included, as are meals and drinks in a fine-dining restaurant and a casual bar/grill. There's also a luxe spa, an outdoor pool and an open-air yoga studio.
